description: This file defines a page component for displaying invoices in a multi-shop billing system. It includes static route generation functions and a React server component that renders a client component to fetch and display invoice data for a specific shop.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters for a list of shops to support static site generation.

methods.name: ShopInvoicesPage
methods.description: Main React component for the shop invoices page. It receives route parameters and renders the invoices client component.
